evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure data promoted to the curated zone meets quality expectations.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize reliable, well-documented datasets, quality expectations, stable schemas, and reusable logic, with no velocity/speed phrases present, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: This work helps make performance transparent and comparable across campaigns and products, enabling faster insights and more confident decision-making.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would affect marketing measurement and business decisions but there is no financial reporting, regulatory, or compliance language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: The Marketing Data team builds the data foundation for marketing measurement and decision-making across products as part of a decentralized data ownership model.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named, specialised Marketing Data team already exists with an established decentralized data ownership model and named tooling (DataHub, Redshift/Spectrum) in responsibilities, indicating mid-stage maturity rather than greenfield or fully mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and maintain the Marketing Data Model (starting with GA4 and Google Ads, expanding as new sources and use cases appear).
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools (GA4, Google Ads, Redshift/Spectrum, DataHub) and concrete deliverables (curated datasets/marts, marketing feedback loop), giving a precise picture of the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Build the marketing feedback loop foundation for automated martech systems by connecting acquisition signals, user behavior, and outcomes in a scalable data layer.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role sits within a Marketing Data team building datasets for marketing measurement, acquisition signals, and campaign performance, making commercial (GTM/marketing) the dominant orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Design and own curated datasets/marts that power self-serve analytics and dashboards (stable schemas, reusable logic).
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns curated datasets and builds new foundational data layers (strategic verbs: design, own, build) but also 'supports' data investigations and self-serve reporting for other teams (execution framing), giving a mixed picture.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is mentioned only in relation to the company's own hiring/recruitment process, not as a skill or tool expected of the candidate in the role itself.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure data promoted to the curated zone meets quality expectations.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is framed as a responsibility the candidate owns and ensures directly, using an ownership verb rather than a bare tool mention.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: We own core marketing analytics datasets and ensure they are reliable, well documented, and usable for both reporting and advanced analysis.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: reliability and data quality of pipelines/datasets are a stated concern, but framing centers on operational trustworthiness rather than compliance or regulatory risk.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build and maintain the Marketing Data Model (starting with GA4 and Google Ads, expanding as new sources and use cases appear).
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities mix building new datasets/marts and a new marketing feedback loop foundation (greenfield) with maintaining and ensuring quality of an existing Marketing Data Model (fix/scale), a genuine mix of both.
evidence.language_gate: Good knowledge of English and Ukrainian or Russian
